case_name: John M. Vassiliades and Eliza Ortizluis Vassiliades v. Commissioner
suitability_reason: Sole issue (American Opportunity Credit) decided purely on failure to substantiate payment of qualified tuition and related expenses in 2018; eligibility elements (dependent, full-time enrollment, eligible institution) were not in dispute.

taxpayer.notes: Joint petitioners; claimed AOC for husband's daughter AM, a full-time student at University College London; AM claimed as dependent. Filing status inferred from joint petition/return, not expressly stated.

adjustments: disallowed $2,500 American Opportunity Credit ($1,500 nonrefundable + $1,000 refundable)
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Claims qualified education expenses were paid for AM at UCL in 2018; records lost in November 2018 burglary.

findings_of_fact.fact: AM enrolled full time at UCL pursuing a bachelor's degree, September 2017 to July 2020
findings_of_fact.snippet: AM was enrolled full time at UCL as a student in the division of medicine, pursuing a bachelor’s degree from September 2017 to July 2020.

findings_of_fact.fact: UCL record shows £3,083 online payment on September 12, 2017 by AM's mother Anna Theorides (not petitioners)
findings_of_fact.snippet: The UCL Student Fees Department notes an online payment on AM’s account of £3,083 on September 12, 2017.
On December 15, 2018, petitioner wired £2,313.57 to AM , converted from $3,000.

findings_of_fact.fact: Claimed AOC: $1,500 nonrefundable and $1,000 refundable; no Form 1098-T received
findings_of_fact.snippet: a nonrefundable education credit of $1,500 and a refundable education credit of $1,000

findings_of_fact.fact: Home burglarized November 4, 2018 with theft of documents
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioners’ home was burglarized on November 4, 2018, resulting in the theft of valuable s and various important documents .

findings_of_fact.fact: Court unable to conclude petitioners paid qualified tuition and related expenses to UCL
findings_of_fact.snippet: from the record before us we are unable to conclude that petitioners paid qualified tuition and related expenses to UCL.

issues.question: Are petitioners entitled to the American Opportunity Credit for 2018?
issues.holding: No; petitioners failed to substantiate payment of qualified tuition and related expenses in 2018.
issues.computable_reason: Turned on substantiation of payments, not on a mechanical test.

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent.

notes: Some facts stipulated; record is stipulation plus husband's testimony. Record left open post-trial; no further evidence produced. AM's age unclear from record.
